name: Paper God: Earth God in His Shrine, Wu Si Palace, with Two Attendants
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink and color on paper; with printed inscription reading from right to left: "Wu Si Gong" ("Wu Si Palace"). Probably from Fengxiang, Shaanxi.
